title: Don’t let the noise of the crowd distract you from your calling. When you level up in the Spirit, the enemy will always try to pull you down with chatter. 🗣️🛡️
paragraphs: Don’t let the noise of the crowd distract you from your calling. When you level up in the Spirit, the enemy will always try to pull you down with chatter. 🗣️🛡️
Keep your eyes fixed on the Cross. Your growth is your testimony, and their gossip is just background noise. Stay focused, keep climbing, and be the Warrior you were called to be.
📖 "I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus." — Philippians 3:14 (NKJV)
